major_concerns: Deterministic validator coverage may be incomplete (false negatives/positives).
Synthetic task bank may limit external validity to production heterogeneity.
Single automated repair iteration may understate benefits/limits of iterative workflows.
Need clear protocol to control LLM run-to-run stochasticity and ordering.
required_design_repairs: Characterize/validate validator coverage (unit tests, known-failure injection).
Include multi-iteration repair arm (and report cost/latency tradeoffs).
Broaden task bank/vendor templates or justify representativeness; document generation rules.
Preregister precise pairing/ordering and randomness controls; log model settings and seeds.
Specify criteria for labeling regressions and ensure blinded labeling where possible.

major_concerns: Paired-evaluation depends on matched ordering rather than true RNG seeding with hosted APIs—possible residual nondeterminism.
High run counts increase model-call budget pressure; power justification needed.
Prompt-framing selection may omit realistic operator styles; coverage risk.
Potential confounding from context leakage across runs if state not isolated.
required_design_repairs: Preregister exact matching protocol for paired runs (ordering preservation, request batching).
Perform power analysis to justify N and optionally reduce runs with stratified sampling.
Define prompt selection process with operator-derived exemplars or literature-grounded templates.
Ensure stateless isolation between runs and log full context, temperature, and other API params.

major_concerns: Rubric scoring may be subjective—risk of low inter-annotator agreement.
Possible circularity if same validator informs rubric component and outcome measurement.
Automated scoring rules need specification to avoid post-hoc tuning.
Risk that observed correlations depend strongly on chosen validator strength.
required_design_repairs: Provide deterministic rubric scoring rules, examples, and annotation guide; preregister annotator selection and blinding.
Measure and report inter-annotator agreement; include reconciliation procedure.
Ensure rubric components are independent of the validator used for outcome (use separate validators or hold-out checks).
Include sensitivity analysis across validator strengths and report robustness.

major_concerns: Ethical risk of releasing adversarial prompts that enable misuse; disclosure must be handled carefully.
Adversarial prompt generation may tempt pre-lock human tuning—must be automated/preregistered.
Attack transferability may be model- and prompt-template-specific, limiting generality.
Validator gaps may dominate results; need to separate exploit vs validator weakness.
required_design_repairs: Define ethics-safe disclosure policy (abstract/obfuscated examples, redacted exploit templates) and justify in preregistration.
Preregister automated adversarial-generation procedures and forbid post-hoc manual crafting.
Test across multiple models or prompt templates to assess transferability; report model-specific effects.
Characterize validator coverage and attribute adversarial success to either generator failure or validator gap via controlled probes.
